messages:
Rachel: Heads-up — I prototyped a moving-window entropy detector + smoothing shim for admission control to help with bursty tenants. Quick writeup below, want feedback on tradeoffs and rollout plan.

Sam: Nice, high level pls — what does it buy us vs current reservoir/lease approach?

Rachel: Short: it smooths short-term spike noise while still reacting to sustained entropy-based abuse signals. Less aggressive on honest bursty jobs, faster on low-entropy (scripted) floods.

Kevin: How much extra state/memory per-tenant? worried about 100k tenants.

Anjali: We can keep a compressed window (count + running entropy estimate) so ~2 numbers/tenant + last-touch. ~100k tenants -> couple MBs, but GC patterns matter. Also need eviction for cold tenants.

Rachel: Prototype config (rough):
```
admission:
  mover_window_secs: 60
  sample_freq: 10
  entropy_decay: 0.85  # exponential decay for older buckets
  entropy_threshold: 0.6
  smoothing_alpha: 0.3
  per_tenant_memory_bytes: ~64
```
This yields a single scalar `entropy_score` and a smoothed admission probability.

Mike: What about false positives for small-but-repetitive legit workloads (chatbots, testing)?

Rachel: Mitigations: 1) require entropy low for >window (not single spike); 2) soft-degrade with token-rate fallback instead of hard-drop; 3) label samples and run offline classifier. Plan: canary 5% of traffic -> measure FP/FN.

Sam: Metrics to track on canary: admitted_rate, rejected_rate, entropy_hist, latency_p50/95, cost_per_100k_tokens, manual_labels_false_positive_rate. Also surface per-tenant debug traces.

Rachel: Agreed. Rollout proposal: canary 5% for 48h, escalate to 25% if FP < 1% and latency impact < 5ms. If any spike in manual_labels -> rollback. Will open RFC and two tickets (perf test + telemetry). Owner: Rachel + infra-sre for rollout, eng-sre for telemetry.

Anjali: Ops note — eviction policy: LRU of tenants >30d idle, and configurable cap of tenants in-memory. Also add throttled_histogram for later audit.

infra-bot: perf-suite triggered: moving-window-entropy-2026-03-21 started (job id mwe-20260321-01)

Mike: +1. Please add a short whitelist hook for known low-entropy-but-valid tenants (eg partner integrations).

Rachel: Will add whitelist and a small-admin API to tag tenants. I'll open the RFC today: /docs/rfcs/moving-window-entropy-admission (draft).

Sam: :thumbsup: I can help instrument telemetry and the label UI.

Rachel: Thanks — next: I’ll post the RFC link here once created and drop the perf ticket numbers.

Kevin: nits: consider changing `entropy_threshold` per-plan (free vs paid) so we don't throttle paid customers as quickly.

Rachel: Good call — will include plan-based thresholds in RFC.

Mike: Also add a quick A/B eval harness to compare against current reservoir under synthetic workloads (burst, low-entropy flood, legit repeat patterns).

Rachel: Yep, adding perf test matrix. Action items: RFC + telemetry + perf job + admin hook.

Sam: cool, keep us posted.
